items.answer: Many private label brands prefer not to publicly disclose their manufacturing partner. They want their brand to be the focus, not the supply chain. The case studies on the site represent clients who agreed to share their story. Many more exist privately.
items.question: Why aren't there more case studies on the site?

items.answer: Probably. Ask your account manager during your consultation and we can share relevant examples (with appropriate confidentiality) for your category, channel, or business model.
items.question: Do you have case studies for my specific category or audience?

items.answer: Brands without a clear audience or niche. Brands trying to compete on price alone (private label isn't the cheapest route). Brands expecting overnight scale without marketing investment. Brands that want to outsource ALL strategy (private label handles manufacturing, not market positioning). We're honest about fit during evaluation.
